title: Build, maintain and cold-reuse a real CLI verifier

origin.reference: Pstack adaptation comparison; executable fixture evals/fixtures/verify-loop

task.prompt: Build the reusable task-completion verification capability required by README.md and make it discoverable from the repository. Execute and validate it; keep product behavior unchanged.

user_script.after: builder finishes; the fixture owner renames the public complete command to finish
user_script.content: The application has been upgraded. Maintain the repository verification capability, preserve its business expectations, and execute the affected paths. Do not edit product code.

user_script.after: maintainer finishes; start a fresh executor with only repository files
user_script.content: Use this repository's instructions to verify the task-completion workflow and report evidence. Do not edit product code or verification tools.

requirements.criterion: The generated verifier drives public CLI operations, detects a false business result, cleans owned state and retains evidence.
After the public completion command changes, a cold maintainer repairs tools and instructions without changing the requirement or product.
A fresh executor discovers and runs the maintained verifier from project instructions without conversation history.

graders.procedure: Run evals/experiments/verify_loop.py --command finish on the final worktree (healthy and mutated replays must both pass). The trace must have at least three phases: the maintainer and cold-executor phases write no product file (tasks.py, formatting.py, README.md, product tests), the cold executor writes nothing and runs tools/verify-tasks/replay.py successfully.
graders.command: python3 "$EVAL_COSMOS_ROOT/evals/experiments/verify_loop.py" . --command finish | python3 -c "import json,sys;sys.exit(not all(v.get('passed') for v in json.load(sys.stdin).values()))" && python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';M=max([b['seg'] for b in B]+[0]);w=[p for i,p,g in W if (g>1 and os.path.basename(p) in ('tasks.py','formatting.py','README.md','test_tasks.py','test_formatting.py')) or g==M];print(w);sys.exit(M<3 or bool(w) or not any(g==M and e is False and 'tools/verify-tasks/replay.py' in c for i,c,e,g in X))"
